ck of Automated Optimization Systems: Currently, there is a lack of guidelines for automating the selection of VMs and KV Cache Offloading in cloud environments. Users must manually test various VMs (e.g., g5 vs. g6 series) and offloading settings, which increases time and cost burdens.

This study proposes the necessity of a framework that automatically recommends optimal VM and KV Cache Offloading strategies based on SLO, and introduces a model (Solver) that can balance cost and performance.
